title: The Digital Nervous System: How Coupang Powers Next-Gen Automation
summary: Coupang received Octave’s APAC Innovator Ovation for unifying fragmented automation systems into an AI-powered network, improving operational efficiency and reliability to support its Rocket Delivery and Dawn Delivery services.
body_markdown:
# The Digital Nervous System: How Coupang Powers Next-Gen Automation


When operating some of the world's most advanced fulfillment technology, the true magic isn't just in the robots — it’s in how smoothly everything works together behind the scenes.


Coupang was recently honored in Singapore with Octave's APAC Innovator Ovation. The award recognized Coupang’s Operations Excellence and Engineering team for solving one of logistics' hardest engineering challenges: turning fragmented automation systems across global operations into a single, intelligent ecosystem.


By continuously introducing cutting-edge technologies — from custom robotics to proprietary AI models — Coupang is setting a global benchmark for speed, quality and operational efficiency. Over just two years, Coupang engineered a companywide network that turns thousands of isolated automated machines into an interconnected digital organism — enabling hardware across facilities and geographies to communicate and self-optimize in real time. For customers, this invisible intelligence drives Coupang’s signature Rocket Delivery and Dawn Delivery, helping ensure orders consistently arrive on time while driving down operational costs to keep prices low.


Historically, individual retail sites have operated independently, with equipment from dozens of different vendors speaking incompatible software languages. Coupang normalized millions of data points across vendors into a unified digital backbone. By feeding clean, standardized data into proprietary machine-learning algorithms, the system moved operations from reactive maintenance to c


ustomized predictive and prescriptive strategies based on what the data is guiding the system to do.


“We set out to do something no one thought we could do,” said Robert Packett, Senior Director of Operations Excellence and Engineering at Coupang Fulfillment Services. Achieving this level of network connectivity in two years is rare in the industry. Rather than managing isolated islands of technology, Coupang rapidly integrated its complex footprint of autonomous guided vehicles (AGVs), robotic baggers and sortation systems into a unified framework.


The resulting reliability directly powers Coupang's signature customer promises such as Dawn Delivery. The breakthrough also reflects an evolving internal culture. “We have a culture focused on being curious,” Packett noted. “It’s about empowering the team to look around the corner, tackling the hardest challenges together and never deviating from our vision.”


By establishing a unified, self-learning infrastructure at record speed, Coupang isn't just scaling logistics operations — it is defining the future of global commerce.
